summary: A Quote subscription on the NIFTY index: the QUOTE packet gives an index frame with the change against the previous close; after Angel drops the socket the subscription is sent again on the new connection, with the same headers.

notes: price_change 50.5 = 24350.5 - 24300.0, percent 0.21 (rounded to 2 places); after the reconnect 60.0 and 0.25.

deviations.reason: data.mode is the label every broker's frames carry on the desktop (ltp, quote, full), as the recorded Zerodha transcripts carry it; this web adapter puts its subscription mode number there.

The web's index quote carries Angel's (zero) last_quantity; the desktop's index frame leaves the quantity fields out, as the recorded Zerodha index transcript does. A field the broker sent must be present (lane wire, presence of every field).
